name: Data Quality Monitor (rules in Postgres, incidents, Telegram Ack/Snooze)

parameters.content:
## Data Quality Monitor
Rules live in the `dq_rules` table (no workflow edits needed). Every 5 minutes the due rules run as read-only queries against your data, results are stored, and an incident opens after N consecutive failures. Alerts arrive in Telegram with Acknowledge and Snooze buttons; recovery is announced; a daily report summarizes everything.

**Setup:** run `sql/schema.sql`, create the read-only role (`sql/readonly_role.sql`), create 3 credentials (Postgres state, Postgres read-only, Telegram), replace the `REPLACE_*` values, add rules (`sql/example_rules.sql`), activate.

### Safety
`Run Check` must use the **read-only** credential with a statement timeout. Table and column names are validated and quoted; `where_clause` and `custom_sql` are screened, and custom SQL is wrapped so it cannot run data-modifying statements. Only rule authors (people who can write to `dq_rules`) can define checks.
Buttons work only for user ids in `ALLOWED_USER_IDS` (placeholder = nobody).

parameters.query:
WITH due AS (
  SELECT id FROM dq_rules
  WHERE enabled AND next_run_at <= now()
  ORDER BY next_run_at
  LIMIT 50
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE dq_rules r
  SET next_run_at = now() + make_interval(mins => r.interval_minutes)
  FROM due WHERE r.id = due.id
  RETURNING r.*
)
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.kind, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.key_columns, c.where_clause, c.window_minutes, c.custom_sql,
       c.min_value, c.max_value, c.anomaly_k, c.severity,
       COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(h.value ORDER BY h.checked_at DESC)
                 FROM (SELECT value, checked_at FROM dq_results
                       WHERE rule_id = c.id AND value IS NOT NULL
                       ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 30) h), '[]'::json) AS history
FROM claimed c
ORDER BY c.id

WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, severity, min_failures, fail_streak FROM dq_rules WHERE id = $1::int FOR UPDATE
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO dq_results (rule_id, status, value, detail)
  SELECT id, $2::text, NULLIF($3::text, '')::float8, $4::text FROM r
  RETURNING id
), upd AS (
  UPDATE dq_rules
  SET last_status = $2::text, last_value = NULLIF($3::text, '')::float8, last_checked_at = now(),
      fail_streak = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'ok' THEN 0 ELSE fail_streak + 1 END
  WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM r)
  RETURNING id
), seen AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents
  SET last_seen_at = now(), occurrences = occurrences + 1, summary = $4::text, severity = (SELECT severity FROM r)
  WHERE rule_id IN (SELECT id FROM r) AND status IN ('open', 'acked') AND $2::text <> 'ok'
  RETURNING id
), opened AS (
  INSERT INTO dq_incidents (rule_id, severity, summary)
  SELECT id, severity, $4::text FROM r
  WHERE $2::text <> 'ok' AND fail_streak + 1 >= min_failures
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dq_incidents i WHERE i.rule_id = r.id AND i.status IN ('open', 'acked'))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), closed AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = now()
  WHERE rule_id IN (SELECT id FROM r) AND status IN ('open', 'acked') AND $2::text = 'ok'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::int AS rule_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM opened)::int AS opened, (SELECT count(*) FROM closed)::int AS resolved

WITH due AS (
  SELECT i.id
  FROM dq_incidents i JOIN dq_rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id
  WHERE i.status = 'open'
    AND (r.snooze_until IS NULL OR r.snooze_until <= now())
    AND (i.last_notified_at IS NULL
         OR (r.reminder_minutes > 0 AND i.last_notified_at <= now() - make_interval(mins => r.reminder_minutes)))
  ORDER BY (i.severity = 'critical') DESC, i.opened_at
  LIMIT 20
  FOR UPDATE OF i SKIP LOCKED
), n AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents i SET last_notified_at = now(), notify_count = i.notify_count + 1
  FROM due WHERE i.id = due.id
  RETURNING i.id
), rec AS (
  SELECT id FROM dq_incidents
  WHERE status = 'resolved' AND NOT recovery_notified
  ORDER BY resolved_at
  LIMIT 20
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), rn AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents SET recovery_notified = TRUE WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM rec)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT i.id AS incident_id, d.event, r.name, r.kind, i.severity, i.summary, i.occurrences,
       i.opened_at, i.resolved_at, i.notify_count
FROM (SELECT id, 'alert'::text AS event FROM due UNION ALL SELECT id, 'recovered'::text FROM rec) d
JOIN dq_incidents i ON i.id = d.id
JOIN dq_rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id
WHERE d.event = 'alert' OR i.notify_count > 0
ORDER BY (i.severity = 'critical') DESC, i.opened_at

WITH inc AS (
  SELECT id, rule_id, status FROM dq_incidents WHERE id = $1::int FOR UPDATE
), ack AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents SET status = 'acked', acked_by = $3::text, acked_at = now()
  WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM inc) AND $2::text = 'ack' AND status = 'open'
  RETURNING id
), snz AS (
  UPDATE dq_rules SET snooze_until = now() + make_interval(hours => $4::int)
  WHERE id IN (SELECT rule_id FROM inc WHERE status IN ('open', 'acked')) AND $2::text = 'snooze' AND $4::int BETWEEN 1 AND 24
  RETURNING id, snooze_until
), rst AS (
  UPDATE dq_incidents SET last_notified_at = NULL
  WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM inc) AND status = 'open' AND $2::text = 'snooze' AND $4::int BETWEEN 1 AND 24
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inc) THEN 'gone'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ack) THEN 'acked'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snz) THEN 'snoozed'
            ELSE 'not_open' END AS outcome,
       (SELECT snooze_until FROM snz) AS snooze_until

WITH d AS (DELETE FROM dq_results WHERE checked_at < now() - interval '90 days' RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS deleted FROM d

SELECT json_build_object(
  'rules',    (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rules WHERE enabled),
  'failing',  (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rules WHERE enabled AND last_status IN ('fail', 'error')),
  'snoozed',  (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rules WHERE enabled AND snooze_until > now()),
  'never_run',(SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rules WHERE enabled AND last_checked_at IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'),
  'stale',    (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_rules WHERE enabled AND last_checked_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND last_checked_at < now() - make_interval(mins => interval_minutes * 3 + 15)),
  'checks_24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_results WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
  'fails_24h',  (SELECT count(*) FROM dq_results WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status <> 'ok'),
  'open_incidents', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
      SELECT i.id, r.name AS rule, i.severity, i.status, i.opened_at, i.summary
      FROM dq_incidents i JOIN dq_rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id
      WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'acked')
      ORDER BY (i.severity = 'critical') DESC, i.opened_at LIMIT 15) x), '[]'::json),
  'noisiest', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
      SELECT r.name AS rule, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status <> 'ok') AS fails, count(*) AS checks
      FROM dq_results s JOIN dq_rules r ON r.id = s.rule_id
      WHERE s.checked_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
      GROUP BY r.name HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status <> 'ok') > 0
      ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5) x), '[]'::json)
) AS report
